spec.name: Nostromo Galley Kitchen
spec.description: A worn commercial-crew galley from a 1979 mining freighter: grated deck, a cluttered counter run of retro appliances under upper cabinets, a central mess table with attached chairs, glowing CRTs and warning signage in yellowed industrial plastic.
spec.layout: Static interior set on a deck of floor grating (the only floor-contact pieces: grating, table base, chairs, oven feet). The back wall runs along z = -2.4 with the galley counter run against it: lower cabinet boxes to y 1.0, worktop at y 1.0-1.06, upper cabinets and a hood from y 1.7 to 2.1. Appliances sit on the worktop and against the wall: a tall oven/range unit on the left, a bulky coffee machine and water boiler centre-right, a wall-mounted CRT monitor with glowing amber screen above the counter. The open galley front (facing +Z) holds a central mess table at z +0.7 with two stools. Every surface is yellowed, flat-panelled retro plastic with recessed inset panels, mustard edge trim, dark charcoal seams, copper conduit runs on the wall, warning stripes at knee height, and one amber CRT plus small red/teal indicator lights as the only glow. Style is blocky 70s industrial: chunky slabs, visible rivets, chunky chunky chunky, no curves beyond cylinders and lathed pots.

parts.builds: The clutter and signage that sells the crew ship: a large painted wall sign on the back wall (warningYellow and blackStripe hazard chevrons plus a creamInset rectangular placard reading as a galley notice with redLight and packetBlue text blocks as flat colour strips); a steelDark fire extinguisher on a wall bracket with a mustardTrim band and hose; a whiteEnamel first-aid box with a redLight cross; a stack of two panelGrey supply crates with creamInset stencil strips and mustardTrim banding in the right floor corner; a hanging rack of three copper pots and lathed pans above the counter end; a floor caddy with a mop and whiteEnamel bucket; three spare coffee cups and a packetBlue food pouch on the counter's far right.
